findings.th: โอทอปพร้อมค้า
findings.text: 117 records (0.1%) carry the three signals a buyer needs at the same time — a category, a contact, and an OPC grade. 20,268 carry two of the three, 28,556 carry one, and 105,109 (68.2%) carry none of the three: a name and an area only.

findings.th: ความเห็นตรงกัน
findings.text: 68.7% of records are attested by more than one agency. Without corroboration, a record is one office's filing; with it, two or more agreed.

findings.th: ได้รับการคัดสรร
findings.text: 13,939 records (9%) carry an OPC star grade. Mean grade of those: 4.01★. 5,317 are 5-star; 4,789 are 4-star.

findings.th: ความเข้มข้น
findings.text: The ten most-filed provinces hold 26.7% of all records. The remaining 67 provinces share the rest.

findings.th: ซ่อนอยู่ในทะเบียน
findings.text: 7,089 records carry a 4-5★ OPC grade but no contact channel. The state has certified them; the system cannot route a buyer to them.

findings.th: ช่วงความน่าเชื่อถือ
findings.text: สตูล is the most cross-attested province (94.5% of its records corroborated by ≥2 agencies); ยะลา is the least (34.4%). Same data source, very different administrative depth.

findings.th: ความสดใหม่
findings.text: 20,989 records (13.6%) carry a filing year. Median filing year is 2022. The other 86.4% cannot be dated from the registry.

findings.th: มาตรฐานผลิตภัณฑ์ชุมชน
findings.text: 1,489 official Community Product Standards (มผช.) from TISI / Ministry of Industry govern technical specifications across the 5 categories (Food: 553, Decor: 461, Beverages: 262, Textiles: 110, Herbal: 103). Every standard carries an official gazette PDF specification.

findings.th: การประมวลรวม 26 หน่วยงาน
findings.text: 1,015,991 rows from 522 open datasets across 26 government publishing offices were harmonized. Deduplication collapsed 273,050 redundant filings (64.0% duplicate inflation) down to 154,050 verified producer entities.

findings.th: ได้รับการรับรอง มผช.
findings.text: 17,235 records (11.2%) carry a Community Product Standard (มผช.) certificate: 10,044 still valid as of 2026-09-11, 7,067 lapsed, 124 undated. 5 are buyer-ready — valid certificate, 4-5★ grade, and a contact channel.
